title: 鼓脸晃头

strip-0.prompt:
Act as a senior 2D inbetween animator. Return a continuous production sheet in EXACTLY the same layout as this reference: THREE columns, FOUR rows, TWELVE equally sized complete square images, read left-to-right top-to-bottom. Fill every square with one fully drawn camera-locked scene. Its white background, screen coordinates, character scale, clothing and props agree with the reference. No grids, numbering, words, motion trails, crossfades or double hands. The attached four rows give A, B, B, C. Create TWO successive micro-actions: top TWO rows are SIX evenly spaced DIFFERENT complete inbetween poses from the first reference A toward B, bottom TWO rows are SIX from B toward C. The six progress values in EACH block are about 10%,26%,42%,58%,74%,90%. Source extremes are supplied separately in the final GIF, so fill ALL cells with precision motion, never six identical drawings. Follow bright clean line art and maintain exact registration and hand identity; no autonomous camera shake. Full story for context: One debut-costume florist Nailü, twin tails, lime streak, heart cowlick, white hair flowers. Both fists near collar. Cheeks inflate; look left, rock the head left-to-right, hair ornaments follow; puff releases and little fists ease.
A = 0.00 s: Draw florist Nailü waist-up in her debut costume, twin tails, lime streak, heart cowlick and white hair flowers; face forward with both closed fists beside her collar.
B = 0.55 s: Keep both fists visible beside the collar; inflate her cheeks halfway, purse her lips and shift her eyes toward her own left.
C = 1.10 s: Fully puff her cheeks and tilt her head left; hold the leftward gaze as twin tails, flowers and cowlick trail toward her right.
Trust the actual illustrated poses in the attachment for the shape, timing and exact action. Preserve figure count and source costume. Never place hands, limbs or extra flowers into adjacent cells.
